title: Rift Moth
text: Rift Moths appear in time and space biomes, usually in flocks of 3–5. Immune to the hazards of both regions, they travel together, drifting near crystals and plants. Their wings glow gold-green in time biomes, blue-violet in space biomes, and alternate between the two in the Spacetime Corridor.
They do not attack, scatter when frightened, and leave no drops.
